title: Psalm 41
opening_line: Blessèd is he that wisely doth

source.note: Received text from the official Free Church digital edition and plain-text archive.

text.diplomatic: Blessèd is he that wisely doth
text.normalized: Blessèd is he that wisely doth

text.diplomatic: the poor man’s case consider;
text.normalized: The poor man’s case consider;
text.reading: the poor man’s case consider;

text.diplomatic: For when the time of trouble is,
text.normalized: For when the time of trouble is,

text.diplomatic: the LORD will him deliver.
text.normalized: The LORD will him deliver.
text.reading: the LORD will him deliver.

text.diplomatic: GOD will him keep, yea, save alive;
text.normalized: GOD will him keep, yea, save alive;

text.diplomatic: on earth he blessed shall live;
text.normalized: On earth he blessed shall live;

text.diplomatic: And to his enemies’ desire
text.normalized: And to his enemies’ desire

text.diplomatic: thou wilt him not up give.
text.normalized: Thou wilt him not up give.
text.reading: thou wilt him not up give.

text.normalized: GOD will give strength when he on bed

text.diplomatic: of languishing doth mourn;
text.normalized: Of languishing doth mourn;

text.diplomatic: And in his sickness sore, O LORD,
text.normalized: And in his sickness sore, O LORD,

text.diplomatic: thou all his bed wilt turn.
text.normalized: Thou all his bed wilt turn.
text.reading: thou all his bed wilt turn.

text.diplomatic: I said, O LORD, do thou extend

text.diplomatic: thy mercy unto me;
text.normalized: Thy mercy unto me;
text.reading: thy mercy unto me;

text.diplomatic: O do thou heal my soul; for why?
text.normalized: O do thou heal my soul; for why?
text.reading: O do thou heal my soul; for why?

text.diplomatic: I have offended thee.
text.normalized: I have offended thee.
text.reading: I have offended thee.

text.diplomatic: Those that to me are enemies,
text.normalized: Those that to me are enemies,
text.reading: Those that to me are enemies,

text.diplomatic: of me do evil say,
text.normalized: Of me do evil say,
text.reading: of me do evil say,

text.diplomatic: When shall he die, that so his name
text.normalized: When shall he die, that so his name
text.reading: When shall he die, that so his name

text.diplomatic: may perish quite away?
text.normalized: May perish quite away?

text.normalized: To see me if he comes, he speaks

text.diplomatic: vain words: but then his heart

text.diplomatic: when forth he doth depart.
text.normalized: When forth he doth depart.

text.diplomatic: My haters jointly whispering,
text.normalized: My haters jointly whispering,

text.diplomatic: ’gainst me my hurt devise.
text.normalized: ’Gainst me my hurt devise.
text.reading: ’gainst me my hurt devise.

text.diplomatic: he lieth, and shall not rise.
text.normalized: He lieth, and shall not rise.

text.normalized: Be blessed for ever then,
text.reading: be blessed for ever then,

text.diplomatic: From age to age eternally.
text.normalized: From age to age eternally.
